verdict.rationale: Pulumi ships AI features, including Neo, an MCP server and agent skills, so a training-data privacy control is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack never mentions an opt-out from AI model training or any data-usage policy. Self-hosting and DIY state backends are adjacent data-residency options, not a training opt-out, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
